messages:
talia: Quick thread: we need a short, operational playbook for resolution caching at the ingress proxy. Small perf hit now but important for scoped-key rollout.

talia: Problem: resolving token -> org/project adds ~0.5ms p50 when done per-request. We can cache but must handle rotation/revocation.

omar: Proposed approach: L1 in-process cache (5000 entries, 1s TTL) + L2 shared Redis (60s TTL) + rotation webhook to delete keys. L1 reduces tail for hot keys.

luca: +1. Add tombstone entries on revoke: store tombstone with small TTL to prevent comeback from stale L2. Also record cache version in telemetry.

talia: Error/rollback rules: if cache invalidation misses and any org sees >0.5% auth anomalies for 5m, auto-disable L2 caching for that org and alert eng-sre.

omar: Implementation note: cache key = sha256(token_fingerprint) to avoid raw token in cache. Also include authz_policy_version in cache value so policy rollouts invalidate when version bumps.

luca: ops-bot: deploy plan?
deploy-bot: branch ingress-cache-resolve pushed to staging, smoke runs scheduled 2025-06-10T02:00Z. Link: https://go/redwood/deploys/ingress-cache-resolve-1768003333

talia: owners: Omar -> cache + webhook; Luca -> tombstone + telemetry; Talia -> playbook + runbook docs. Please ack so I can stamp the runbook PR.
omar: ack
luca: ack
